_doc: Physics questions that ask to see a diagram (draw: true), and look-alikes that ask to see none (draw: false). physics_diagram_eval.py sends each to a running API and reads the reply's pictures. kind: the picture a right answer draws (vectors: arrows held to the question's directions and sizes; free_body, incline, atwood, pulley, projectile, circuit, rays, collision, pendulum). arrows (vectors only): each stated arrow as [size, compass direction of travel], which the drawn arrows must match.

draw.prompt: Two roads are perpendicular and meet at a junction. Car A of mass 1000 kg travels along one road at 20 m/s due North. Car B of mass 1300 kg, travels due West along the other road at 16 m/s. At the junction the cars collide and move together. a) Write down the initial velocities of the cars before collision in vector form. b) Find the velocity of the cars after collision. First draw a diagram of the cars before collision
A car travels at 15 m/s due east and a truck travels at 10 m/s due north towards the same intersection. Draw a diagram showing their velocities before they collide.

Two ice skaters collide and hold on to each other. Skater A of mass 60 kg moves east at 4 m/s and skater B of mass 50 kg moves north at 3 m/s. Draw a diagram of the skaters before the collision and find their velocity afterwards.

A truck of mass 3000 kg moving east at 10 m/s collides with a car of mass 1000 kg moving north at 20 m/s, and they lock together. Draw a diagram of the vehicles before the collision and find their common velocity.
A ball of mass 0.2 kg moving at 5 m/s to the right hits a ball of mass 0.3 kg moving at 2 m/s to the left. Draw a diagram of the balls before the collision.
A hiker walks 3 km north and then 4 km east. Draw a vector diagram of her displacements and find her resultant displacement.
Two forces of 6 N and 8 N act on a point at right angles to each other. Draw a diagram of the forces and find the resultant force.
A boat heads due east across a river at 4 m/s while the current flows due south at 3 m/s. Draw a velocity vector diagram and find the boat's resultant velocity.
A plane flies at 200 m/s due north while a wind blows at 50 m/s due east. Sketch the velocity vectors and find the plane's resultant velocity.
Two tugboats pull a ship, one with a force of 5000 N due east and the other with 3000 N due north. Draw a diagram of the forces on the ship and find the resultant force.
A swimmer swims due north at 1.5 m/s across a river flowing due east at 2 m/s. Draw the velocity vectors of the swimmer and the river.
A force of 20 N acts at 30° above the horizontal. Draw the force and its horizontal and vertical components, and find each component.
Draw a free-body diagram of a 5 kg box resting on a horizontal table.
A 10 kg block slides down a 30° incline with a coefficient of friction of 0.2. Draw a free-body diagram of the block and find its acceleration.
A 2 kg mass hangs from a string attached to the ceiling. Draw a diagram showing the forces on the mass and find the tension in the string.
Two masses of 3 kg and 5 kg hang from the ends of a string over a frictionless pulley. Draw a diagram of the system and find the acceleration of the masses.
A 4 kg block on a smooth horizontal table is connected by a light string over a pulley at the edge to a hanging 2 kg mass. Draw a diagram of the system and find the acceleration.
A ball is kicked at 20 m/s at 40° above the horizontal from level ground. Sketch its path and find its range.
A stone is thrown horizontally at 15 m/s from the top of a cliff 45 m high. Draw a diagram of its motion and find how far from the base of the cliff it lands.
Draw a circuit diagram of a 12 V battery connected to two resistors of 4 Ω and 6 Ω in series, and find the current.
Three resistors of 2 Ω, 3 Ω and 6 Ω are connected in parallel across a 6 V battery. Draw the circuit diagram and find the total current.
An object is placed 30 cm from a converging lens of focal length 10 cm. Draw a ray diagram and find the image distance.
A ray of light passes from air into glass of refractive index 1.5 at an angle of incidence of 40°. Draw a diagram showing the refraction and find the angle of refraction.
A car of mass 1200 kg is pulled forward by a driving force of 3000 N against a friction force of 600 N on a level road. Draw a free-body diagram of the car and find its acceleration.
A box is pulled along a rough floor by a rope at 25° above the horizontal with a tension of 40 N. Draw the forces acting on the box.
A 0.5 kg ball moving at 6 m/s strikes a stationary 1 kg ball and they stick together. Draw a diagram of the balls before the collision and find their speed afterwards.
A simple pendulum has a length of 1.2 m. Draw the pendulum and find its period.
A ship sails 40 km due east and then 30 km due south. Draw a diagram of its journey and find its displacement from the start.
A drone flies at 12 m/s on a heading 30° east of north, and a wind blows at 5 m/s due east. Draw a vector diagram of the two velocities.

look_alikes.prompt: Car A of mass 1000 kg travels at 20 m/s due north and car B of mass 1300 kg travels at 16 m/s due west. They collide at a junction and stick together. Find their velocity after the collision.
What is a vector? Explain the difference between speed and velocity.
Draw a conclusion: is momentum conserved when two cars collide and stick together?
Why does drawing a diagram help when solving collision problems?
A car travels due north at 20 m/s for 10 s. How far does it travel?
Show that momentum is conserved when a 2 kg ball at 3 m/s hits a 1 kg ball at rest and they stick together.
A hiker walks 3 km north and then 4 km east. How far is she from her starting point?
